jobs.title: AI & Data Graduate Programme 2027
jobs.description:
# EY AI and Data Graduate Programme 2027

Source: https://eyglobal.yello.co/jobs/o-mdBAMr_pP3Go7vsz0GaQ?job_board_id=c1riT--B2O-KySgYWsZO1Q
Supporting programme page: https://www.ey.com/en_ie/careers/what-you-can-do-here/student-programmes/programmes/graduate-programmes2/consulting-graduate-programme/consulting-career-options#data
Verified: 14 September 2026
Requisition: 1737553
Location: Cork or Dublin Wilton Park, Ireland
Service line: Consulting
Programme: Two years, 2027 intake
Application deadline: 21 October 2026

## Opportunity

EY describes its AI and Data practice as helping clients unlock value from data and technology by turning complex information into actionable insights. Work spans multiple industries and includes operational efficiency, compliance, risk management, and strategic decision-making.

Graduates work with experienced practitioners on varied client projects. The programme includes cross-functional collaboration, hands-on training with analytical tools and platforms incorporating AI and GenAI capabilities, work on real-world industry challenges, and collaboration with EY alliance partners.

Applicants choose a preferred client group: all-industry clients across Consumer and Health, Industrials and Energy, Government and Infrastructure, Technology, Media and Telecommunications, and Private; or Global Financial Services clients across banking, wealth and asset management, insurance, fintech and payments, aviation finance, and structured finance.

## Candidate requirements

- Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and the ability to explain ideas, insights, and recommendations to varied audiences.
- Adaptability, openness to learning, and comfort in a rapidly changing environment.
- Curiosity, purpose, and a habit of asking thoughtful questions.
- Interest in applying AI tools responsibly, recognising suitable use cases, seeking guidance, using feedback, and continuing to develop as technologies evolve.
- Inclusive collaboration that values different perspectives and builds trust.
- On track for a 2:1 degree or higher; the general EY graduate page states that equivalent qualifications are accepted.
- Valid right-to-work status must be in place by the programme start. EY's FAQ says Consulting and Technology graduate programmes are among those that may support sponsorship conditions, but this is not a candidate-specific sponsorship commitment.

## Application context

EY permits one Graduate Programme application. The form also asks candidates to choose second and third programme preferences and a preferred client group. A requisition-specific Yello account or login is required. No account was created, no information was entered, and no application was submitted.
